text:
emily: Heads-up — while QA'ing the v1->v2 migration guide I hit an edge case: streaming responses with model-swap redirects don't preserve user-supplied stop sequences. Repro steps below.

raj: thanks, can you paste the minimal repro?

emily: repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/responses -d '{"model":"old/gpt-3r","input":"hello","stop":["\\n\\n"]}'` then follow redirect to `rwd/gpt-3r-v2` — streaming chunk contains tokens past the stop.

docs-maria: ack, this sounds like the snippets need update and a note about fallback behavior. If the routing proxy rewrites the model param we should call out that stop sequences are only guaranteed when the target model supports identical stop semantics.

devex-tyler: where should the note live? migration guide or streaming guide?

emily: both — migration guide for v1->v2 users, streaming guide for runtime semantics. Also update the snippets in /examples/ and add a smoke test.

olivia: product ok with adding a deprecation banner for the old models endpoint? legal requested 30 days notice before breaking changes.

raj: agreed. I'll open a PR to change the redirect mapping and add tests to the smoke-test harness (make sure CTS covers stop preservation).

raj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (draft) — includes redirect config + test stub.

docs-maria: assigning myself to the PR. I'll update the prose and add a short code example using `client.responses.stream` and the compatible model alias (eg `rwd/gpt-3r-v2`).

tim: FYI runtime side — model-swap redirect currently rewrites model_name but doesn't touch stream metadata. We'll add a unit test for stop preservation and a fallback that injects a server-side stop if the client stop is lost.

deploy-bot: New deploy scheduled for docs site tomorrow 03:00 UTC :calendar: — changes in PRs will go out after review.

devex-tyler: also need to update TS and Py SDK snippets that use `models.create` endpoint; add compatibility wrapper example that shows `wrapForV1()` usage.

emily: one more: add a tiny CLI snippet for `rw-migrate` that lists affected routes and suggests replacements, plus a link to the SDK migration checklist.

docs-maria: will add redirects config patch and a short FAQ entry titled "Streaming + model swap: stop sequences". ETA EOD.

olivia: set cross-team review for 14:00 in calendar, invite sent.

emily: :thumbsup: Thanks all — ping me if you need repro logs or more sample traces.
